_comment: Rolled 1 night in 3, plus anything an encounter queued. `effects` is the same flat dictionary encounters use. `faction_at_most`/`faction_at_least` gate an event on standing, so section 4's punishments and rewards arrive as events rather than special cases. `blocked_by` names a building effect that prevents it. `tone` colours the line in the night report. `omen` is the warning the Free Road passes on when it is pleased with you.

events.text: Someone went through the stores in the dark. Five of your food and five of your water are gone, and nobody saw a thing.
events.omen: Cass says there are hands about at night. Watch the stores.

events.text: A Crown column arrives before dawn with a writ and no interest in discussing it. They take a third of what is in the box.
events.omen: There is a revenue column on the highland road, moving fast.

events.text: The ford runs thin overnight and what you drew comes up brackish.
events.omen: The highland streams are low. Water will be short.

events.text: Damp got into the stores. What is left is fit for animals and little else.
events.omen: The air has turned. Anything not sealed will spoil.

events.text: A traveller who took a bed does not wake. Nobody knows his name, and the road takes the news with it.
events.omen: There is fever on the east road.

events.text: An inspector counts your beds, your stores and your walls, writes nothing down, and leaves before breakfast.
A merchant who stopped here weeks ago leaves a crate on the step. No note, no name, good wine.
Nothing at all happens. The fires burn down, the road is empty, and the town sleeps.
A Crown courier leaves a sealed purse: the season's stipend, for a crossing that has kept its side of the bargain.
Three families come through in the dark without stopping. They will not say what is behind them, only that it is coming.
events.omen: The east road is filling up. Whatever is on it will reach the ford.
